purpose: Recorded amendment to the SHA-256 locks of the original pre-registrations. A locked file may change only for a bug fix; the change is listed here with the exact old and new hashes, and verify.py still re-runs every pre-registered held-out result with the changed file, which must reproduce.

amendments.reason: two bugs found by the 2,000,000-case adversarial property test (tests/test_shield_properties.py): I1 was not re-checked after clamping; an out-of-bounds replica request moving toward the bounds was blocked instead of passed (minimal intervention). C++ shield changed identically (adversarial parity 0 mismatches).
amendments.evidence: verify.py re-runs the pre-registered held-out seeds and the fleet held-out runs with the fixed shield; their checks pass unchanged.

amendments.reason: omni-v15 (docs/OMNI_V15.md, section 1): the brain's request for the power cap trims to demand only while the response line has been clean for the caller's own clear time (observe_vector carries obs slo_clean; a caller that senses no line is clean). On the omni-v11 long run (run 39173420146) the request switched between the start limit and the trim at 126 of 350 decisions; on the same decisions the gate leaves 35 (tests/test_cap_band.py). C++ twin changed identically (tests/test_cpp_governor_parity.py, results/SEAL.json).
amendments.evidence: The stack simulator and the benchmark hand the brain no slo_clean, so every decision reads the line clean and takes omni-v14's branch: verify.py re-runs the pre-registered held-out seeds and the fleet held-out runs with the amended file, and their checks pass unchanged.

amendments.reason: omni-v16 (docs/OMNI_V16.md): the brain keeps its own minute whatever its caller's step. Governor.period_s (60 s unless the caller says otherwise): a step of k = period_s / 60 of the minute blends the observation with weight 1 - (1 - 0.339)^k, advances the engine k of its macro interval, counts the dwell and the wait before a give-back in seconds, and keeps the machines added or removed within up_max and down_max over the last minute's steps. At 60 s every value is omni-v15's. The Kubernetes governor passes its decision period (omni_controller/controller.py). C++ twin changed identically (tests/test_cpp_governor_parity.py at 60, 15, 10 and 5 s; results/SEAL.json).
amendments.evidence: The stack simulator and the benchmark step the brain at its own minute (period_s 60), so every step takes omni-v15's path: verify.py re-runs the pre-registered held-out seeds and the fleet held-out runs with the amended file, and their checks pass unchanged.
